Integer overflow and malformed offsets require implementation validation; none occurs here.

samples.claim: Initialize prev_row to 0..=n and curr_row to n+1 zeros. For each s1 char set first current cost i+1; each s2 char has substitution cost0 when equal else1; current[j+1] is min(previous[j+1]+1,current[j]+1,previous[j]+cost), then swap row buffers. Return prev_row[n]. Time is O(m*n) after O(m+n) character collection; two DP rows use O(n), but total auxiliary storage includes both character vectors and is O(m+n). Row width follows s2, not min(m,n). No early cutoff, Result, unsafe code, shared state or IO exists; allocation/arithmetic failures are not caught.
samples.review_note: Matches DP recurrence; supplementary1-29 confirms both Unicode vectors, early empty cases and total storage bound.

samples.claim: PackedStruct is the legacy fixed-width form: row-by-row concatenation of fixed-width children, repeated uint64 bits_per_value=1 specifying each contribution and CompressiveEncoding values=2. VariablePackedStruct is a 2.2 extension with repeated FieldEncoding fields=1 in struct order. Each child is independently compressed before row-major transposition, preserving field compression boundaries but disabling mini-block compression. FieldEncoding.value=1 describes compression and layout selects bits_per_value uint64=2 or bits_per_length uint64=3 for variable-length prefixes. The prose says readers prefer this form when present and fall back to legacy; the enclosing union makes the concrete selection explicit (protos/encodings_v2_1.proto:658-675).
samples.review_note: Matches fixed/variable packed metadata and comment-level2.2 contract; oneof mapping manually reviewed earlier this turn.
